id: Mamma Mia! Here We Go Again (2018)

facts.text: Grilled on the terrace, the summer of 1979.
facts.why: In 1979 Donna stays in the abandoned farmhouse that later becomes the hotel, so a terrace grill does not show in the plot.
facts.fix: Summer of 1979, back before the hotel.

vibe.verdict: A pretty hotel front desk idea that uses Paris, Bill's boat and the storm, but the food is generic Greek and the big musical numbers are missing.
missing: Cher's Ruby arriving to Fernando (the party)
Donna and the Dynamos in denim flares (the stage)
Alexio the fisherman getting back to his love (Bill's boat)
The horse in the storm (the farmhouse)
Sofia handing over the farmhouse (Donna's pregnancy)
ideas: Swap 'Ouzo over ice and water' note for 'Fernando, pouring for Ruby at last'
Swap the 'Kalokairi tomato keftedes' note for 'Bill's boat, one very slow lift'
Swap 'Room 1979' door hanger for 'Dynamos denim flares, size generous'
Swap 'Fried saganaki' note for 'Alexio's thank you catch'
